identity.name: MetaTravelers: Nibiru
identity.notes: The historical generic MetaTravelers Tier-C row maps to the 7,777-item Nibiru avatar collection, not later Elements/Factions products. Official March 2022 documentation proves usable GLB, FBX, VRM and Animaze .avatar file types were available in the Nibiru avatar ecosystem; the unresolved issue is exhaustive file enumeration/access, not whether avatar formats shipped.

evidence.note: Historical Nibiru launch listing records the project's Discord invite. Current official site no longer foregrounds Discord, so it is retained as historical rather than asserted current.
Current official site links the MetaTravelers X account.
Historical collection record resolves the Nibiru launch to Nov. 6, 2021.
OpenSea collection identity independently anchors the Nibiru collection and contract.

avatar_formats.note: The project's own March 3, 2022 file-flow documentation calls these its currently available 3D file types and demonstrates Nibiru avatars in a custom GLB viewer, Unreal/VRChat contexts, Webaverse via VRM, and Animaze. FBX is therefore not ruled out: it was an explicitly supported avatar deployment format. Exact per-token URLs have not yet been recovered.

evidence.note: Official MetaTravelers article dated Mar. 3, 2022 describes currently available .GLB, .FBX, .VRM and .AVATAR file types for the avatar ecosystem and maps them to avatar/metaverse use cases.

avatar_inventory.note: Usable avatar files definitely shipped, including GLB/FBX/VRM, but the literal catalog still needs an exhaustive supported-format asset lane or a recoverable holder download/index. This state must remain incomplete until actual asset URLs are enumerated.

evidence.note: Official article presents the current available file flow rather than a future-only roadmap.

ip_rights.summary: Contemporaneous 3D-avatar research and launch material described MetaTravelers avatars as holder-owned/downloadable characters with commercial-rights intent, but a current controlling primary Nibiru holder license was not recovered. The catalog therefore records the historical commercial-rights signal without inventing exact derivative, redistribution, or sublicensing scope.

evidence.note: MetaTravelers entry marks commercial rights and downloadable-avatar intent while listing file format/status as unresolved at the time.
Current site confirms continuity of the MetaTravelers character/IP business but does not expose a controlling historical Nibiru license in the material reviewed.

project_status.note: MetaTravelers remains an active character/IP business. The current official site continues to market the universe and current physical/digital character products; current product fulfillment extends into 2026.

evidence.note: Current official product surfaces describe active Wave 1 physical/digital character fulfillment into 2026.
